# Vietnam Thermal Power Plant Reference Inventory (>30 MWe)

> **Methodology note:** This inventory is compiled from parametric knowledge of Vietnamese government documents (National Power Development Plan VII, VII Revised, and PDP8), EVN/PVN/TKV corporate disclosures, and international energy databases as of my knowledge cut-off (early 2025). Because I cannot browse the internet, URLs are provided as canonical document addresses known at training time — readers should verify live availability. Where precise unit-level data is uncertain, ranges or best estimates are noted. Plants are grouped by fuel type, then province.

---

## ⚠️ Important Caveats

1. **No live web access:** All data reflects training knowledge ≤ early 2025. PDP8 (Decision 500/QĐ-TTg, 15 May 2023) is the primary planning reference; amendments issued in 2024 may alter some entries.
2. **Source URLs** are canonical addresses of known documents — not verified live links.
3. Unit MW figures for older plants are nameplate/net capacity as commonly reported; minor discrepancies exist across sources.
4. Plants <30 MWe (e.g., small diesel, mini-gas turbines) are excluded.
5. "COD" for multi-unit plants lists first unit / last unit where known.

---

### 1C — Coal Plants Approved / Planned (PDP8)

> **Note:** PDP8 (Decision 500/QĐ-TTg, 2023) significantly curtailed new coal approvals. Vietnam committed at COP26 to phase out unabated coal by 2040. PDP8 lists no new coal plants beyond those already under construction, and explicitly schedules retirement of pre-2000 subcritical units by 2030–2035.
